label: Wave Dark Matter

assumes.label: Ultralight mass
assumes.description: The assumption that the dark matter particle is extremely light (around 10⁻²² eV), so its de Broglie wavelength reaches galactic scales.

attrs.description: Bosonic matter which behaves like a wave on sub-galactic scales due to coherence of wave functions at cold temperatures with a small mass.

review: The assumption "Ultralight mass" came from relation e66 (Wave Dark Matter exhibits Interference): the long de Broglie wavelength is what makes interference visible. Sophie to confirm it belongs here rather than with "is a class of Dark Matter".
